result.title: Advances in Agentic Computer Graphics
result.summary: Computer graphics is built on code. Large language model (LLM) agents can now generate graphics code and iteratively refine it through various feedback. This capability opens the door to a potentially new paradigm of computer graphics, with graphics algorithms increasingly built around agentic systems to automate progressively complex tasks. Over the past years, research on agentic graphics has expanded rapidly across a diverse range of tasks. This rapid growth makes it increasingly difficult for manual literature reviews to keep pace with new developments. At the same time, similar ideas are often described using different terminology across these tasks, further complicating efforts to develop a systematic understanding of the field. In this report, we address these challenges through two contributions. First, we introduce a unified taxonomy for characterizing agentic systems across diverse computer graphics tasks. Second, we develop an agentic literature system that can assist human researchers in analyzing existing and newly published papers at scale. Building on these contributions, we analyze emerging research trends and discuss open challenges in coordinating agents and tools across graphics tasks, designing interfaces and representations for human-agent collaboration, sustaining long-horizon planning and refinement, and reliably evaluating interactive graphics systems.

AI.brief_summary: 该报告为「agentic computer graphics」领域提出统一的分类体系，并构建一个可辅助研究者大规模分析已有与新增论文的 agentic 文献系统，据此梳理研究趋势与开放挑战。
AI.relevance_reason: 其中关于反馈驱动迭代细化、长时程规划以及可靠评价交互式系统的讨论，可能为 LVR 的多轮状态更新、停止决策与评测设计提供类比线索；但论文关注图形代码生成，缺乏内部视觉表示的实质联系，可供核查。
